🔥 The fire settles. Henry has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still — I put it down today." "Its legs lock. White light wells behind its eyes." "It drops its head — the antlers come around in a short, vicious arc." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ikram says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." the man in his 50s, with a scarred cheek mutters "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
🛡️ Brian, Grayson, Juan and Daniyar met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Brian, Grayson, Juan, Daniyar are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ikram just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikos just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Henry just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Yayan taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Daniyar Askarov, 33 — a paramedic. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Green Whisper, Cold-Blooded, Green Thumb, Literally, Berserker Rage, Translator.
Yayan: "The ground elder patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."
You start in on Bamboo Shoot, Sugar Maple, Ground Elder, Salmonberry too — and they grin. "Old news, friend. Thabo showed us that one." Still: you carried it home. That's the job.
🛡️ Nabil and Ofori met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Nabil, Ofori are hurt.
